extracted.name: Easy Microwave Chocolate Mug Cake
extracted.description: This chocolate mug cake recipe is easy to make in the microwave for a deliciously decadent and fudgy chocolate dessert in less than 10 minutes!
instruction_lines: Whisk flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking soda, and salt together in a large microwave-safe mug; stir in milk, canola oil, water, and vanilla extract.
Cook in the microwave until cake is done in the middle, about 1 minute 45 seconds.
